Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Patination time course: decay kinetics of the AP-1 chromatin layer
ideas.description: Inspired by 'patination' (a surface layer that accrues with repeated exposure and persists), stimulate cells for varying doses/durations, withdraw the stimulus, and profile FOS/JUN CUT&RUN, ATAC-seq, and H3K4me1/H3K27ac over hours to weeks at the same loci. Memory is supported if accessibility and H3K4me1 outlive AP-1 occupancy and accumulate with the number of prior exposures rather than resetting to baseline.

ideas.title: Bimodal single-cell re-response test
ideas.description: Taking the word 'bimodal' as the signature of a discrete latent state, use single-cell RNA/ATAC plus a live AP-1 target reporter to compare naive versus previously stimulated populations upon restimulation, testing statistically for bimodality rather than a uniform graded shift. Confirm that the high mode corresponds to cells retaining accessibility at AP-1 sites.

ideas.title: 'Unshifted' clonal barcode lineage tracing of the primed state
ideas.description: Memory must survive mitosis, so barcode cells, stimulate, sort responders, expand, and restimulate to ask whether responsiveness re-concentrates in the same barcodes. Sister-cell split experiments then quantify how many divisions the correlation persists, giving a heritability half-life for the AP-1 primed state.

ideas.title: Evacuative degron: separating establishment from maintenance
ideas.description: Tag endogenous FOS, JUN, and JUNB with dTAG/AID degrons and acutely deplete them either during the initial stimulus or only during the post-stimulus memory window. Persistence of memory after post-hoc depletion implies AP-1 writes a chromatin mark it no longer needs to hold, whereas collapse implies continuous AP-1 occupancy is itself the memory.

ideas.title: Vocabulary-without-grammar MPRA of AP-1 enhancer syntax
ideas.description: Echoing a word list that has lexicon but no syntax, build an integrated massively parallel reporter library varying AP-1 motif number, spacing, affinity, and flanking partner motifs (TEAD, RUNX, lineage factors). Measure which configurations sustain elevated output after stimulus withdrawal to determine whether memory resides in AP-1 sites alone or in their grammatical context.
